description: Independent expectation ledger for the MSP payment and synthetic CWF check. Every expected value was derived by hand from the cited source; none were copied from COBOL output or fixtures/expected.json. Cases run as ONE ordered batch (state reset depends on order).

sources.Pub. 100-05 Ch. 5: CMS MSP Manual, §10.1, §40.8-40.8.3; PDF https://www.cms.gov/Regulations-and-Guidance/Guidance/Manuals/Downloads/msp105c05.pdf (SHA-256 a2ea49af2675c75ee617961723848016fee55f80b74aa7716b22fa38e10af693 per docs/rules.md)
sources.Pub. 100-04 Ch. 27 \u00a720: CMS Claims Processing Manual, CWF pre-payment validation (as summarized in docs/rules.md)
sources.README: Demo interface contract in README.md (record layout, codes, precedence, limits). Interface cases test these demo decisions, not CMS policy.

conventions.symbols: C charges, G gross, P primary, D deductible, K coinsurance, A contract/OTAF, B = A if present else C, T = D + K. Payment = lowest of G-P, G-T, B-P, B-T, floored at 0; 0 if full=Y.
conventions.zero_reasons: README order: PAYMENT_IN_FULL, PRIMARY_AT_CAP (P >= min(G,B)), DEDUCTIONS_AT_CAP (T >= min(G,B)); positive -> SECONDARY_PAYABLE
conventions.defaults: mbi 7POLICY0001 and dos 20250601 when a case omits them
conventions.patches: [offset0, text] overwrite bytes of the serialized record; text is encoded as Latin-1 so \u00e9 is the single byte 0xE9
conventions.raw: truncate_to N keeps the first N bytes; append adds bytes
conventions.invalid: README: invalid claims are NOT_SENT/CLAIM_INVALID with 0 payment and 0 released

cwf_reference.note: Own synthetic CWF reference data for this ledger (not fixtures/cwf.json). Fictional MBIs.
